paper_metadata.title: A strong-yet-ductile high-entropy alloy in a broad temperature range from cryogenic to elevated temperatures

evidence.section: Abstract
evidence.quote: we innovatively designed a nanoparticle-strengthened high-entropy alloy (HEA) through elaborate compositional design and thermomechanical regulation.

evidence.section: Conclusion
evidence.quote: In this study, we designed a novel nanoprecipitation-strengthened HEA with superior mechanical properties across a wide temperature range (196~1000 °C) through elaborate compositional design and thermomechanical regulation.
